origin: TMM original quests informed by ATM10 structure; no copied quest prose

rules.each_quest_requires: positive experience and a purposeful fixed item reward, except specifically justified coin-only exchange/merchant quests
rules.reward_shortcuts: no fixed item reward equals another authored item criterion; shop purchases intentionally bypass bad-luck but cannot bypass progression locks
rules.criteria_reuse: never duplicate an objective by accident; the six explicitly designated copper/emerald/diamond sell-tier item IDs are intentionally reused with different counts and item consumption
rules.overview_placeholders: until authored, minimal paper + XP checkmark rewards

quests.title: Welcome to Too Much Magic
quests.description: A magic-first modpack with many independent schools. Introduction gives you the essentials, Progression connects systems, and the other groups guide individual mods. Check this entry when you have read it.

quests.title: Punch a Tree
quests.description: Pick up any log or stem to receive one 27-slot Trinkets Pouch automatically per player. Claim this quest's experience and torches separately. Do not place portable bags inside other bags; cross-mod enforcement is still in development.

quests.title: Make a Crafting Table
quests.description: Craft a table to unlock the familiar 3x3 crafting grid. It is a useful baseline before you explore magical crafting.

quests.title: Make a Wooden Pickaxe
quests.description: Craft your first wooden pickaxe. Ordinary tools are an easy way to get established before specializing in magic.

quests.title: Gather Stone
quests.description: Collect sixteen cobblestone. Stone is useful for your first shelter, tools and furnace.

quests.title: Upgrade to Stone
quests.description: Make a stone pickaxe so you can mine sturdier resources.

quests.title: A Place for Your Things
quests.description: Craft a chest for early base storage. Magic eventually offers more specialized options than generic storage networks.

quests.title: Light the Furnace
quests.description: Craft a furnace. Smelting remains useful alongside later magical processing.

quests.title: Find Your First Iron
quests.description: Bring back three raw iron. Magical mining and transmutation will eventually provide alternatives.

quests.title: Iron Pickaxe
quests.description: Craft an iron pickaxe. You now have the baseline tools to choose your first magical specialty.

quests.title: Begin a Library
quests.description: Craft a book to begin collecting magical research and manuals. Akashic Tome can organize compatible guides without replacing each school's progression.

quests.title: Tips & Tricks Index
quests.description: These optional read-and-check tips cover tools, keys and systems that a large modpack makes easy to overlook. The tips are not compulsory progression gates.

quests.title: Find Recipes with JEI
quests.description: Use Just Enough Items to explore recipes and item usages. Check both directions before assuming a resource has only one way to obtain it.

quests.title: Identify Blocks with Jade
quests.description: Jade identifies blocks and creatures under your crosshair and can display useful supported-mod information.

quests.title: Sort Your Inventory
quests.description: Inventory Tweaks ReFoxed provides inventory sorting and refill features. Middle-click sorting depends on key bindings and the container; Mouse Tweaks also changes dragging and scrolling.

quests.title: Use Crafting Tweaks
quests.description: Crafting Tweaks can rotate, balance or clear a normal crafting grid. Test those controls before assuming they work in a modded ritual interface.

quests.title: Search the Controls Screen
quests.description: Use the controls search to find conflicting mod keys. KeyBind Bundles can help organize different play styles.

quests.title: Gather Your Guidebooks
quests.description: Akashic Tome can collect compatible magic manuals into one book. Not every guide is compatible and you may need to acquire some books individually.

quests.title: Curios and Portable Bags
quests.description: Curios provides extra equipment slots. Never nest portable bags: Ars Elemental has a partial blacklist, but Occultism and ProjectE require more complete safeguards before survival release.

quests.title: Claim Your Base
quests.description: Use FTB Chunks to claim an area around your base. Chunk loading depends on server settings; protection and backups solve different problems.

quests.title: Understand Lootr Chests
quests.description: Lootr supports per-player loot in many generated chests. Exact behavior can depend on the structure and container.

quests.title: Plan for Death
quests.description: Corail Tombstone changes recovery after death. Learn how graves work before a dangerous expedition, and keep backups while death-handler compatibility is under review.

quests.title: Search Biomes
quests.description: Nature's Compass can locate biomes relevant to exploration and magic. It is not a Waystone or teleport system.

quests.title: Resolve Recipe Conflicts
quests.description: Polymorph can help when multiple recipes have the same ingredients. Check the intended output before spending scarce materials.

quests.title: Understand Character Growth
quests.description: Pufferfish's Skills and Attributes will support the custom skill tree; Improvable Skills is separate. The two do not share a unified point pool.

quests.title: Zoom and Overlay Controls
quests.description: Just Zoom and More Overlays Updated offer visual aids. Adjust key bindings if they conflict with other mod controls.

quests.title: Food & Fishing Index
quests.description: Farming, fishing and cooking offer useful alternatives to combat foraging. Explore these branches independently and use JEI for the many additional Pam's HarvestCraft recipes.

quests.title: Start with Seeds
quests.description: Collect wheat seeds to start a farm. The installed food mods offer many additional crops as you explore.

quests.title: Prepare a Field
quests.description: Craft a stone hoe to till farmland. Harvest with Ease can make managing mature crops simpler.

quests.title: Bring in the Wheat
quests.description: Harvest four wheat. Ordinary grains form a foundation for many more elaborate meals.

quests.title: A Patch of Sugar Cane
quests.description: Collect three sugar cane. Sugar and paper support cooking and magic books.

quests.title: Raise a Chicken Dinner
quests.description: Acquire raw chicken. Farmer's Delight and Pam's HarvestCraft offer cooking options beyond simple smelting.

quests.title: Gather Eggs
quests.description: Collect two eggs for cooking recipes.

quests.title: Fresh Milk
quests.description: Get a bucket of milk. Many recipes need useful basic farm products as well as exotic ingredients.

quests.title: Ready Your Fishing Rod
quests.description: Craft a fishing rod and start exploring another renewable food route.

quests.title: Catch a Cod
quests.description: Catch cod using a rod. A small fishing expedition can feed a player before a serious farm is built.

quests.title: Catch a Salmon
quests.description: Catch salmon in suitable water. Aquaculture expands this side of the game.

quests.title: Aquaculture: Iron Rod
quests.description: Craft Aquaculture 2's iron fishing rod. Use JEI for its current exact recipe.

quests.title: Aquaculture: Gold Rod
quests.description: Progress to an Aquaculture gold fishing rod. This is a distinct milestone, not another copy of the iron-rod objective.

quests.title: Aquaculture: Neptunium Rod
quests.description: Obtain the rare Neptunium fishing rod as an optional long-term goal rather than an early prerequisite.

quests.title: Light a Campfire
quests.description: Craft a campfire to cook basic food on the road.

quests.title: Farmer's Delight: Cutting Board
quests.description: Craft Farmer's Delight's cutting board to prepare ingredients outside the normal crafting grid.

quests.title: Farmer's Delight: Cooking Pot
quests.description: Make a cooking pot and use it with heat and ingredients for more satisfying meals.

quests.title: Find the Seed Market
quests.description: Craft Farming for Blockheads' Market for ordinary seed and sapling trades. Magical seed trades must be audited before survival release.

quests.title: Pam's HarvestCraft: Fried Chicken
quests.description: Craft a finished Fried Chicken from Pam's HarvestCraft 2 Food Core. A useful optional cooking challenge.

quests.title: Pam's HarvestCraft: Starfruit
quests.description: Obtain starfruit from Pam's HarvestCraft 2 Trees, showcasing specialty plants and orchard progression.

quests.title: Use the Quest Shop
quests.description: Use /hqs shop to browse a curated list of convenience supplies, common magical materials, exploration finds, and specific Artifacts. Quest Shop coins belong to your FTB Team. Ordinary quests generally give thematic item rewards; specialized resource-selling quests pay coins.

quests.title: Cooking for Blockheads: Cooking Table
quests.description: Build the Cooking Table to discover dishes available from nearby kitchen ingredients. Cooking for Blockheads works alongside Farmer's Delight and Pam's HarvestCraft, expanding an organized base kitchen.

quests.title: Cooking for Blockheads: Oven
quests.description: Build an Oven to expand the modular kitchen. Check recipes and heating behavior in JEI and test compatibility with food ingredients before automating the kitchen.

quests.title: Sell Copper I — First Trade
quests.description: Submit 8 pieces of copper as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Copper II — Regular Buyer
quests.description: Submit 32 pieces of copper as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Copper III — Packed Shipment
quests.description: Submit 16 blocks of copper as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Copper IV — Industrial Exchange
quests.description: Repeatable bulk sale: submit 256 full copper blocks (4 stacks) for a single coin. The items must be consumed. After ProjectE unlocks, manufacturing large quantities for shop currency is an intended late-game option.

quests.title: Sell Emeralds I — First Trade
quests.description: Submit 2 pieces of emeralds as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Emeralds II — Regular Buyer
quests.description: Submit 8 pieces of emeralds as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Emeralds III — Packed Shipment
quests.description: Submit 16 blocks of emeralds as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Emeralds IV — Industrial Exchange
quests.description: Repeatable bulk sale: submit 128 full emeralds blocks (2 stacks) for a single coin. The items must be consumed. After ProjectE unlocks, manufacturing large quantities for shop currency is an intended late-game option.

quests.title: Sell Diamonds I — First Trade
quests.description: Submit 1 pieces of diamonds as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Diamonds II — Regular Buyer
quests.description: Submit 4 pieces of diamonds as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Diamonds III — Packed Shipment
quests.description: Submit 8 blocks of diamonds as a one-time sale. The exchange consumes the materials and credits your team's Quest Shop balance with one coin. Later tiers require larger deliveries.

quests.title: Sell Diamonds IV — Industrial Exchange
quests.description: Repeatable bulk sale: submit 64 full diamonds blocks (1 stack) for a single coin. The items must be consumed. After ProjectE unlocks, manufacturing large quantities for shop currency is an intended late-game option.
